tagline: Free, curated Islamic video courses from public sources

blockers.title: Neon database connection
blockers.detail: Everything else for accounts is built and tested. Add two Cloudflare secrets (Workers & Pages → talaqqa → Settings → Variables and Secrets): DATABASE_URL (Neon pooled connection string) and BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (a long random string, e.g. from a password manager). Add DATABASE_URL as a GitHub Actions secret too, so migrations run on deploy.

blockers.title: Google sign-in app (later in Phase 2)
blockers.detail: I'll send exact steps when I reach sign-in: a Google Cloud OAuth client with the site as redirect URL, then GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET as Cloudflare secrets.

blockers.title: Launch details
blockers.detail: (1) Turn on Web Analytics: Cloudflare dashboard → Workers & Pages → talaqqa → Metrics → Web Analytics → Enable. (2) Custom domain name (and whether it's on your Cloudflare account). (3) An email for private removal requests.

blockers.title: Trusted channels for auto-publish
blockers.detail: List the YouTube channel IDs (start with UC) you trust in content/discovery/config.json → trusted_channels. Until then, everything the engine finds goes to a review PR.

blockers.title: Content gaps
blockers.detail: 40 courses now. Thinnest areas: advanced Hadith and Usul al-Fiqh, and Arabic taught in Arabic. Name teachers you want prioritised.

phases.name: Launch
phases.goal: Real users can learn Arabic and Islam step by step, from the basics to advanced, with no account.
phases.outcome: Anyone can open the site on a phone, pick the Arabic or Islam path, start at Foundations, play lessons in order, and keep their progress on their device.
phases.releaseNotes: v0.1 public beta at https://talaqqa.pages.dev: Learn Arabic and Learn Islam paths (Foundations → Advanced), 25 curated courses from recognised teachers and institutions, YouTube player with speed, autoplay, auto-next and resume, progress, Watch later, playlists and notes on the device, search with filters, installable PWA with offline pages, SEO (sitemap, structured data), trust pages, error logging, security headers, CI with a real-browser player check.
definitionOfDone: Live on the real domain over HTTPS, deployed by CI from main.
5 to 10 approved courses; every video ID verified as real, public and embeddable; every lesson credits the teacher and links to the original.

Phone smoke test passes on the deployed build: install the PWA (Android prompt, iOS hint), play a lesson, mark complete, save to watchlist, 'continue where you left off', go offline and browse visited pages, see the offline notice on a lesson.
Lighthouse (mobile) on home, course and lesson pages: Performance 90+, Accessibility 95+, SEO 100, Best Practices 95+.
Valid sitemap, canonical tags, Open Graph, Course and VideoObject JSON-LD (Rich Results Test passes).
An Arabic (RTL) test page renders without layout breaks.
About, Content guidelines, Report a problem / request removal, and Privacy pages are live and linked in the footer.
README, CONTRIBUTING, LICENSE, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, issue templates, CI (build + content validation + type check) green on main.
You have approved the content and said 'launch'.

phases.name: Data and accounts
phases.goal: Reliable catalog data, and progress that follows the learner across devices.
phases.outcome: Sign in on a phone and a laptop and see the same progress, watchlist, playlists and notes. Lessons show real durations, and dead videos are caught automatically.
definitionOfDone: A learner signs in on two devices and sees the same progress, watchlist, playlists and notes.
Guests can still browse and learn without an account; their device data imports on first sign-in.
Offline changes sync when the device is back online, without duplicates.
Lesson pages show real durations; VideoObject passes the Rich Results Test.
The weekly job flags dead or private videos and opens an issue.
Auth is rate-limited, cookies are httpOnly + Secure, every API route enforces ownership; tests cover this.
Privacy page updated; account deletion works.
Deployed to production and smoke-tested on a phone.

changelog.text: 8 courses from the first weekly discovery run (40 courses, 891 videos, all playable): Meeting Muhammad ﷺ (Yaqeen), Aqeedah Semester 1 (Zad Academy), Fiqh of Fasting and Zakat (SeekersGuidance), Stories of the Prophets and Mothers of the Believers (Yasir Qadhi), al-Fawzan's 40 Hadith explanation, and Quranic Arabic Stages Two and Three. 18 finds blocked. The engine now skips playlists that never mention Arabic or Islam (it had found two medical lecture series).

Accounts and sync API merged and deployed to production (switched off until the database is connected). The deploy's player check now ignores YouTube's own errors behind its bot check for CI runners; real visitors are unaffected.

Accounts and sync API built and tested without waiting for the database: Hono + Better Auth on Cloudflare, last-write-wins sync of learner data, export and deletion, CSRF and ownership checks, rate limits; migrations with a runner; CI runs API tests on real Postgres. Turns on when DATABASE_URL is set.
Filled the Advanced level: 7 more courses (32 total, 703 videos, all playable). 18 candidates rejected and blocked (other languages, re-uploads, vlogs, recitation-only, unknown channels).

Phase 2 approved (Cloudflare API, email+password and Google sign-in, hono / better-auth / Neon driver / zod). First increment: YouTube metadata for all 599 lesson videos, durations and upload dates on pages and structured data, weekly dead-video check. Fixed: weekly jobs' pushes never triggered a deploy.
Phase 1 v0.1 released at https://talaqqa.pages.dev with release notes and retrospective. Phase 2 plan proposed for approval.

UI pass: bottom tab bar on phones, sticky video with scrolling lesson list, icon action chips with Share, sticky Continue bar on course pages, subject chips on home. Fixed a desktop lesson layout bug, the install banner hidden behind the tab bar, and a layout shift on My courses.
Analytics and error monitoring: CSP + privacy page ready for Cloudflare Web Analytics; built a small error logger on Cloudflare Pages Functions (no new service or dependency).
Astro 7.3.8 security upgrade merged (PR #2). Owner confirmed videos play on their phone.

Launched: PR #1 merged, production live at https://talaqqa.pages.dev. Fixed videos not loading for returning visitors (service worker routed YouTube through itself and our CSP blocked it); added a real-browser player check to every deploy. Astro security upgrade opened as PR #2.
Filled content gaps: 10 more courses (Seerah, Aqeedah, Tazkiyah, intermediate Fiqh and Quran). 25 courses total; every home category row now has real content.

Published 15 real courses (owner asked for automatic selection), removed all demo content, production build passes. Engine now orders newest-first playlists, drops duplicates and compilations. Fixed a phone overflow on search.
Review page for the 25 drafts on the preview (/review/), playable on a phone. Fixed the offline page not showing for unvisited pages. Tested install prompts (iPhone hint, Android button).

v1 LMS brief: Postgres schema, Udemy-style course page, topic pages, Netflix-style home with Continue Watching and category rows, playlists, Watch later, notes, search with filters, playlist-aware auto-next, README with creator roadmap. Previews now deploy to Cloudflare on every push.
YouTube key working. Discovery engine ran on real data: 25 drafts for review. Fixed language/dialect leaks. Deploy workflow now creates the Pages project itself.

Lighthouse mobile: 99–100 across the board. Deploy workflow added (Cloudflare Pages previews per PR, production from main). Tested the Astro 7.3.8 security upgrade in a scratch copy; awaiting your decision. Sent a phone walkthrough video.
GitHub access fixed: branch pushed and PR #1 opened into main. CI now also runs the engine tests.

Added the discovery engine (your choices: trusted teachers auto-publish, free word-list sentiment, built now). Video-first redesign. Player with speed, autoplay, auto-next, resume. Security headers. Applied your engineering guidelines: no new dependencies, timeouts, env-only secrets, tests.

Phase 1 started on demo content. Built the curriculum (Learn Arabic and Learn Islam, Foundations → Advanced, subjects), path pages, catalog by subject, on-device progress, PWA offline + install prompt, SEO, trust pages, CI and templates. Proposed the content discovery engine. All still local: GitHub push blocked.
